caption: We cut through AI hype with practical tests. These prompts help you evaluate ROI, risk, and long-term viability. Save this post and follow @naelbuildingbig. Which prompt will you test first? #AIforBusiness #AIPrompts #Entrepreneurship #Productivity

slides.title: AI Hype vs Usefulness?
slides.body: Practical tasks win. Test ideas against real results, not glossy promises. Try these 5 prompts.

slides.title: 1. Quick ROI Screen
slides.body: Evaluate ROI of AI project: [idea]. Return a table with impact, cost, feasibility and a go/no-go score.

slides.title: 2. Identify Quick Wins
slides.body: List 3 quick wins for [idea] that save time within a week; output bullets with estimated hours saved.

slides.title: 3. Assess Risk Levels
slides.body: Map risks for [task] and assign a severity score 1–5; output a risk matrix and recommended mitigations.

slides.title: 4. Compare Costs
slides.body: Estimate total costs for [idea], including setup and maintenance; output an itemized budget and breakeven point.

slides.title: 5. Long-term Viability
slides.body: Forecast 12-month viability for [idea] and output a short narrative plus 3 indicators to watch.

slides.title: Takeaway: Real Impact Wins
slides.body: Test for real impact, not buzz. Save this post and follow @naelbuildingbig.
